title: Fenty Beauty moves into ‘wearable beauty tech’ with Casetify phone accessories range
summary: Singer Rihanna’s Fenty Beauty has teamed up with Casetify on a limited edition collection that spans phone cases, straps and charm hooks, and also securely pairs miniature versions of the make-up brand’s hero skus with the accessory brand’s hands-free technology

extraction.key_fact: Fenty Beauty가 Casetify와 손잡고 휴대폰 액세서리 한정판 컬렉션을 선보인다.
